description: This Java class EmployeeDTOConverter provides static methods for converting Employee domain objects into EmployeeDTO data transfer objects, including related projects.

classes.name: EmployeeDTOConverter
classes.description: A utility class for converting Employee objects into EmployeeDTO objects, including associated projects.

methods.name: convertToEmployeeDTO
methods.description: Converts an Employee domain object into an EmployeeDTO, including mapping project information.

methods.name: getProjectForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a set of Project objects associated with the Employee from its EmployeeProject associations.
